description: Appointment to the Post of Surveyor General
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-10-21 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Mr. Y.G. Gnanathilaka, who served as the Surveyor General in the Survey Department of Sri Lanka, has retired from the Public Service on 2025-10-01. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Land and Irrigation to appoint Mr. N.K.U. Rohana, Additional Surveyor General, the most Senior of the Special Grade of the Sri Lanka Surveyors Service, to the vacant post of Surveyor General, with immediate effect, was approved by the Cabinet.
